name: hotel-erp-backend
description: APEX Multi-Outlet Restaurant ERP - Python FastAPI Backend

scripts.build: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt || python -m venv .venv && .venv/Scripts/pip install -r requirements.txt || pip3 install --break-system-packages -r requirements.txt || pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.start: .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-10000} || .venv/Scripts/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-10000} || python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-10000}
